snippet.title: NFSMW Remastered v3.5
snippet.description:
NFSMW Remastered v3.5

Whats new: 
- reworked sunny day/sunset cycle
- added an alternative reshade preset #2 (with no dirty lens flare effect)
- new hq textures 

Music: Vlog Chill Stylish Event by Infraction ⧸ Loss Of Sleep 

Join my paid telegram channel to get access to the modification 
Access - https://telegram.me/nfsmwr_bot or just type @nfsmwr_bot directly into Telegram’s search bar.
Thank you!
